welcome.text: Hello! I am KIT VOX, the Knotopian Institute of Technology voice assistant. How can I assist you today?

get_attendance.text: Your attendance record has been retrieved from the college database.

get_timetable.text: Here is your class timetable schedule.

get_my_requests.text: Here are your submitted student requests.

list_pending.text: Here are the pending student requests awaiting review.

leave_date_prompt.text: Which date do you need leave for? You can say today or tomorrow.

leave_reason_prompt.text: What is the reason for your leave?

od_date_prompt.text: Which date do you need On-Duty for? You can say today or tomorrow.

od_event_prompt.text: What is the event name for your On-Duty?

request_id_prompt.text: Which request ID would you like to review?

confirm_leave.text: You are requesting leave. Shall I submit this request? Please confirm with yes or cancel with no.

confirm_od.text: You are requesting On-Duty. Shall I submit this request? Please confirm with yes or cancel with no.

confirm_approve.text: You are about to approve this request. Do you confirm this action? Please say yes or no.

confirm_reject.text: You are about to reject this request. Do you confirm this action? Please say yes or no.

action_confirmed.text: Confirmed. Your action was executed successfully.

action_cancelled.text: The action was cancelled. What else can I help you with?

college_info.text: Knotopian Institute of Technology is an autonomous engineering institution in Coimbatore.

get_courses.text: KIT offers programs in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, and Electronics.

get_eligibility.text: Admission requires sixty percent in Physics, Chemistry and Math in higher secondary.

get_holidays.text: Here are the upcoming college holidays.

get_exam_dates.text: Here is the official examination schedule.

login_required.text: Please sign in with your student or teacher account first.

repeat_prompt.text: I didn't quite catch that. Could you please repeat your request?

unknown.text: I didn't recognize that command. You can ask for attendance, timetable, exam dates, or submit leave.

error.text: The operation could not be completed at this time.
